verdict.rationale: First-party docs repeatedly describe Typesense as open source, including an "open-source server" and Cloud as the hosted version of the "Open Source product". The source is published at github.com/typesense/typesense, and a community member independently confirms reading it: "written in C++, and the code is simple enough to skim." Missing for 10: the specific license is never named in the evidence (no license identifier or terms cited).
